title: The Weeping Statue
text: A saint in grey stone, her face worn smooth by centuries of hands, weeps clear water into a bowl at her feet. The bowl never fills. The water never stops. Dead flowers lie heaped around her, from pilgrims long gone.

options.label: The healer drinks the saint's tears, and takes her grief inside them.

outcomes.text: The water is cold and it stays cold, a well inside them.
They sleep badly ever after. They will not say what the saint shows them.

options.label: Leave her to her grief. Some sorrows are not yours to share.

outcomes.text: Her weeping follows you a long way.
